set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java fun odataEscape(s) = s replace "'" with "''" var fields = read(p('sharepoint.classification.fields'), 'application/json') var selectClause = (fields ++ ['Id']) joinBy ',' var filterClause = "FileRef eq '" ++ odataEscape(vars.processingUrl) ++ "'" --- vars.documentLibrary ++ '?\$select=' ++ selectClause ++ '&\$filter=' ++ filterClause]

logger.doc:name: Log Classification Query Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - WARNING: Could not query source classification metadata for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {errorType: error.errorType.identifier, errorDescription: error.description}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var items = vars.sourceListItems default [] var item = items[0] default {} var wanted = read(p('sharepoint.classification.fields'), 'application/json') --- { (wanted filter ((f) -> item[f] != null) map ((f) -> { (f): item[f] as String })) }]

logger.doc:name: Log Classification Query Result
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "ok" var items = vars.sourceListItems default [] var item = items[0] default {} var msg = "IDP Subscriber - DEBUG: Classification query executed for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: { query: vars.classificationSourceQuery, itemsFound: sizeOf(items), availableKeysOnMatchedItem: keysOf(item), matchedFields: keysOf(vars.classificationProps default {}) }) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log No List Item Found
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - WARNING: Classification lookup returned no matching list item for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ") - check the FileRef filter and library name" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log No Classification Fields Matched
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var wanted = read(p('sharepoint.classification.fields'), 'application/json') var msg = "IDP Subscriber - WARNING: Classification lookup found a list item but none of the configured fields (" ++ (wanted joinBy ', ') ++ ") matched any key on it - Output CSV will have no classification columns copied. File: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Classification Write Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - WARNING: Could not copy classification columns onto Output CSV for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ")" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, env: p('mule.env') })]

logger.doc:name: Log Unexpected Classification Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Subscriber - WARNING: Unexpected error while copying classification metadata for file: " ++ (vars.fileName default 'unknown') ++ " (library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') ++ ") - Output CSV will proceed without classification columns" --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {errorType: error.errorType.identifier, errorDescription: error.description}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]
